steps.caption: token 1,000 at the input; one row per layer above it
local layer: each query reads one window back
next local layer: one more window of reach
3 local layers: reach 3 windows, window still 1
full-attention layer: reach jumps to the whole context
layer 5 (local) at 60,000: every input already carries it

notices.claim: After three local layers the lit band reaches about three windows past token 1,000 (13,285), while the dashed window each layer reads is still one window wide.
One full-attention layer lights its whole row: every later position now carries token 1,000's information.
Layer 5 only reads 55,905-60,000, yet position 60,000 depends on token 1,000, because every input in that window was written by the full layer; five local layers alone would reach only 21,475.
